issues.what: the arch, loop strands, and spicule glow are brighter than the target, and the arch highlights run cyan-white instead of amber
issues.fix: pull the arch and limb glow down and warm the loop highlights back to the target amber

issues.what: native crops of the arch and loops are hotter than the target, with highlight channels pushed toward cyan-white
issues.fix: reduce arch and loop highlight intensity and remove the cool bloom so the strands match the target

issues.what: dark lanes and spot shadows are lifted, so surface contrast is flatter than the target while the highlights stay put
issues.fix: drop the shadow floor on the photosphere and restore the dark intergranular lanes and umbra

issues.what: granulation lanes and active-region shadows are lifted and slightly warmer, so the disk has less contrast than the target
issues.fix: lower the shadow floor on the solar surface and cool the lifted lanes back toward the target

issues.what: faint stars and dust-lane highlights are dimmer than the target, especially on the right flank
issues.fix: bring the faint star and nebular highlights back up without lifting the black floor

issues.what: every feature sits about one pixel to the right of the target, and the disk is a hair warmer
issues.fix: shift the frame left by one pixel and cool the disk slightly toward the target

issues.what: native features sit about two pixels right and one pixel up of the target crops
issues.fix: shift the native frame left two pixels and down one pixel

issues.what: features sit about one pixel right and one pixel down, and the sky floor is slightly lifted
issues.fix: shift the frame left one pixel and up one pixel, and drop the sky floor to the target black

issues.what: native features sit about one pixel right and one pixel down of the target crops
issues.fix: shift the native frame left one pixel and up one pixel
